title: Cloud Connector event logs: state changes for health, tunnels, gateways and upgrades

prose.text: Event logs are the connector's record of its own state changes. They are the streamed signal for tunnel, gateway, health-check and upgrade transitions.

prose.label: Event types.
prose.text: {{event-combinations}} The names in that list and the example values of the event-name field are spelled differently {{divergence:event-name-spellings}}.

checks.do: Which spelling of the event name the SIEM actually receives, from a sample record, before writing a filter on it.
Whether an upgrade alert keys on UPGRADE_END with severity Error, which carries the Fail status.

when-generated.statement: A Cloud or Branch Connector generates an Event log when a status change occurs for a connector health check, Zscaler data center reachability, a data plane health check, a software upgrade, a control plane health check, or a tunnel to Zscaler data centers.

quotes: Zscaler Cloud Connector or Branch Connector generates the Event logs when a status change occurs for a Cloud Connector or Branch Connector health check, Zscaler data center reachability, a data plane health check, a software upgrade, a control plane health check, or a tunnel to Zscaler data centers.

attributes.statement: Each Event log carries date and time, metadata and nine event-specific attributes (four attribute type and value pairs and an error code), whose values depend on the event type and severity.

quotes: Each Event log has date and time, metadata, and event-specific attributes in it. The event-specific attributes depend on the type and severity of the event.
There are 9 event-specific attributes in each Event log:
Attribute 1 Type: The data type for the first event attribute.
Attribute 1 Value: The value for the first event attribute.
Attribute 2 Type: The data type for the second event attribute.
Attribute 2 Value: The value for the second event attribute.
Attribute 3 Type: The data type for the third event attribute.
Attribute 3 Value: The value for the third event attribute.
Attribute 4 Type: The data type for the fourth event attribute.
Attribute 4 Value: The value for the fourth event attribute.
Error Code: The error code associated with an event if an error code is available.

event-combinations.statement: The article's list of all possible Event Type/Severity combinations is ZIA_TUNNEL Info and Error; ZIA_GATEWAY Warn (twice), Error and Info; SVC_HEALTH_CHECK Info and Error; INST_HEALTH_CHECK Warn and Info; CONTROL_PLANE Info and Error; DATA_PLANE Info and Error; UPGRADE_START Info; and UPGRADE_END Info and Error.

quotes: The following list shows all the possible Event Type/Severity combinations that can occur:

gateway-switch.statement: ZIA_GATEWAY Warn events record a switch between the primary and secondary gateway (previous state Secondary and current Primary, or the reverse), with the gateway name; ZIA_GATEWAY Error records a change from Active to Inactive.

instance-degraded.statement: INST_HEALTH_CHECK Warn records a change from Active to Degraded with the number of active instances and the total instances; INST_HEALTH_CHECK Info records the return from Degraded to Active.

quotes: Attribute 3 Type: Number of active instances

upgrade-events.statement: UPGRADE_START (Info) carries the current version, the new version and the package name; UPGRADE_END carries the current version, an upgrade status of Success for Info and Fail for Error, and the package name.

quotes: Attribute 2 Value: Success for Info, Fail for Error

event-name-spellings.impact: A SIEM filter or alert written against one spelling may never match the records the feed sends.
